question:
Which sentence has the correct adjective order:
Options:
(A) ridiculous pyramidal big leather sock
(B) ridiculous big pyramidal leather sock

segments.text: We need to determine correct adjective order.
In English, the typical order: opinion, size, age, shape, color, origin, material, purpose.
So sentence B: ridiculous big pyramidal leather sock.
Option A: ridiculous pyramidal big leather sock: order wrong because size after shape.
